title: Add attribution/source field to map
description: Add a text input field (e.g. in the Style or Export tab) where users can specify a data source attribution (e.g. 'Source: BPS 2024'). Display it on the map canvas near the legend or bottom edge, and include it in PNG exports. Store the value in mapStore and persist it in project state_json.

title: P3: Polish & Export
Implement Tooltip on hover with province name and value
description: Div absolutely positioned over map. Updated on OL pointermove event. Shows province name (bold) + value (IBM Plex Mono) or 'No data'. Dark bg #1a1a2e, white text, rounded, shadow.

title: Composite legend into PNG export using html2canvas
description: Use html2canvas to capture legend div, composite onto map canvas during export. Also render map title text at top of export image.

title: Create sample CSV files with realistic data for all 38 provinces
description: Three sample files in public/samples/: sample_gdp_per_capita.csv (by name), sample_hdi.csv (by pcode), sample_population_density.csv (by name). Realistic values for all 38 provinces.

title: Add Load Sample buttons and JoinStatus badge
description: Sample data buttons in DataTab: GDP per Capita, HDI, Population Density. JoinStatus component showing matched/unmatched counts. Warning banner if matched < 19.

title: Mobile read-only layout
description: Below 768px: sidebar hidden, map fills full screen. Floating bottom sheet with Upload button opening modal. Map is read-only (zoom/pan only).

title: Final design polish
description: Spacing, typography, transitions. Ensure all design tokens are applied consistently. Verify Playfair Display, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono usage.

title: P2: Styling & Classification
Implement colorUtils.js with all presets and chroma.js
description: Color ramp presets: Sequential (Blues, Greens, Reds, YlOrRd, Viridis, Magma) and Diverging (RdBu, BrBG). buildColorScale function using chroma.scale().classes(). Support reverse toggle.

title: Build ColorRampPicker component
description: Visual grid of ramp options showing color swatches. Click to select preset. Reverse toggle button. Show active selection.

title: Implement classificationUtils.js with quantile, equal interval, jenks
description: Use simple-statistics: quantile breaks, manual equal interval, ckmeans for Jenks. Output numClasses+1 break values. Support manual breaks mode.

title: Connect classification + color to live map style updates
description: When color preset, classification method, or numClasses change in store, recompute breaks and color scale, update vector layer style function in real time.

title: Build ClassBreakEditor for manual breaks
description: Input fields for manual break values when classMethod is 'manual'. Validate breaks are ascending. Store in manualBreaks array in Zustand.

title: Add all style controls to StyleTab
description: Color ramp picker, classification method dropdown, classes slider (3-9), stroke color/width pickers, no-data color picker, map title input, legend title input, show province labels toggle.

title: Implement Legend overlay with 4-position cycling
description: Absolute positioned div inside map container. Shows legend title, color swatches with range labels, no-data swatch. 4 snap positions (TL/TR/BL/BR) via cycling button. Semi-transparent white bg.

title: Improve color ramp picker with grouped dropdown
description: Replace the current color ramp picker with a dropdown/select component that groups presets by category (Sequential, Diverging, Qualitative) separated by visual dividers. This allows adding more ramp options without cluttering the UI. Use chroma.js brewer scales as the source. Show a color preview swatch next to each option.

title: Add share to social media buttons
description: Add social media sharing buttons (Twitter/X, Facebook, LinkedIn) for public projects. Two share modes: (1) Share link — opens a share dialog with the project URL pre-filled, and (2) Share image — exports the current map as PNG and shares it. Place buttons in the Export tab and/or in the view-only mode watermark area. Use Web Share API where available, with fallback to platform-specific share URLs.

title: P4: Deploy
Process and bundle final indonesia_provinces.geojson
description: Download GADM 4.1 level-1, simplify with mapshaper (5%), filter water polygons, retain only ADM1_PCODE/province_name/province_name_en. Target <1.5MB raw, <400KB gzipped. 38 features.

title: Write README.md
description: Project description, features, tech stack, local development setup, deployment instructions.

title: Add GitHub Actions deploy workflow
description: Create .github/workflows/deploy.yml: on push to main, checkout, setup node 20, npm ci, npm run build, deploy with peaceiris/actions-gh-pages.

title: Test deploy and verify at ismailsunni.id/petakarta
description: Run npm run deploy. Verify live site works correctly at https://ismailsunni.id/petakarta. Check base path, GeoJSON loading, all functionality.

title: Upgrade save project feature with Save, Save As, Rename, New Project
description: Upgrade project management from single modal to header toolbar workflow. See PLAN-save-project.md for full plan. Key changes: add activeProjectName to store, project toolbar in header (Save/Save As/Rename/New), refactor ProjectsPanel to browse-only focus.

title: P1: Core Map & Data Join
Scaffold Vite + React + Tailwind project with base: '/petakarta/' config
description: Initialize project with Vite 5, React 18, Tailwind CSS 3, and shadcn/ui. Set base: '/petakarta/' in vite.config.js. Install all dependencies from PRD Section 11.

title: Implement Sidebar with tabbed layout
description: Fixed 320px sidebar, scrollable, 3 tabs: Data/Style/Export. Build DataTab with upload + column mapping + Apply button. Stub StyleTab and ExportTab for P1.

title: Create Header and Footer components with design tokens
description: Header: app name 'PetaKarta', tagline, GitHub icon. bg: ink, text: paper, height: 52px. Footer: credits line, height: 32px. Add design tokens to tailwind.config.js and Google Fonts to index.html.

title: Initialize OpenLayers map in MapView with OSM basemap
description: Create MapView.jsx with OL map. OSM tile layer, View centered at [118, -2.5] zoom 5, minZoom 4, maxZoom 12. Map fills flex-1 between header/footer. All OL mutations in useEffect hooks.

title: Load and render indonesia_provinces.geojson as vector layer
description: Load pre-processed GADM 4.1 GeoJSON from public/data/indonesia_provinces.geojson. Render as VectorLayer with neutral gray fill. 38 provinces with ADM1_PCODE property. Implement Fit to Indonesia button.

title: Implement Zustand store (mapStore.js)
description: Single Zustand store with all state: csvData, csvColumns, keyColumn, keyType, valueColumn, joinResult, style settings (colorPreset, classMethod, numClasses, etc.), annotation state, and UI state. Derived values computed via selectors.

title: Implement CSV upload with PapaParse in DataTab
description: Drag-and-drop zone + file browse. Parse CSV with PapaParse (header: true, skipEmptyLines: true, dynamicTyping: true). Store results.data and results.meta.fields in Zustand. Column mapping dropdowns for province key and value columns.

title: Implement province join logic in provinceMatcher.js
description: Join CSV to GeoJSON features. ID mode: exact match on ADM1_PCODE (case-insensitive). Name mode: normalize + direct match on province_name + alias lookup table. Return { matched, unmatched, unmatchedKeys, valueMap }.

title: Apply joined data to map as basic choropleth
description: Style function reads valueMap, applies color per feature based on value. No-data provinces get noDataColor. Update vector layer style via setStyle(). Single color ramp for P1.

title: Basic PNG export via OL canvas API
description: Export map canvas to PNG. Composite OL canvas layers. Download as indonesia-map-{timestamp}.png. No legend composite yet (P3). Standard and high-res (2x) options.

title: Investigate inkmap for print-quality map export
description: Evaluate https://github.com/camptocamp/inkmap as an alternative to the current html2canvas-based PNG export. Inkmap generates print-quality maps from OpenLayers specs with proper DPI control, which could improve export quality for publications. Assess: browser compatibility, bundle size impact, API compatibility with our OL setup, and whether it supports custom overlays (legend, title, attribution).

title: Remove legacy mapStore.js and datasetsStore.js (dead code)
description: mapStore.js and datasetsStore.js are legacy stores fully superseded by layerTreeStore. They duplicate state (activeProjectId, viewMode, activeTab, userLayers) causing confusion. mapStore is still imported by authStore for resetData() on sign-out. Steps: (1) update authStore to only call layerTreeStore.reset(), (2) remove mapStore.js and datasetsStore.js, (3) remove any remaining imports/references, (4) delete stateMigrations.js if only used by mapStore.

title: Delete StyleTab.old.jsx (dead file)
description: src/components/Sidebar/StyleTab.old.jsx (303 lines) is a leftover from the refactor to the unified layer tree style system. It's not imported anywhere. Delete it.

title: Fix broken vitest setup (tests don't run locally)
description: 'npm run test:run' fails with 'vitest: not found'. Either vitest is missing from devDependencies or node_modules needs reinstall. CI workflow runs this command so it may also be failing there. Verify vitest is in package.json devDependencies, run npm install, and confirm tests pass.

title: Remove unused ol-layerswitcher dependency
description: ol-layerswitcher is listed in package.json dependencies but is not imported anywhere in the codebase. The app uses a custom BasemapControl component instead. Remove it to reduce bundle size.

title: Add React error boundary around MapEditor
description: If a layer's GeoJSON is malformed or a Supabase call fails during render, the entire app crashes with a white screen. Wrap MapEditor (or App) in a React error boundary that shows a friendly error message with a 'Go to PetaKarta' recovery link, similar to the existing shareError UI.

title: Optimize downloadDataset to skip redundant public URL fetch
description: downloadDataset() tries the public URL first on every call, causing an extra failed HTTP request for private buckets. Either cache whether the bucket is public after the first attempt, or just use the authenticated download path directly (the bucket requires auth based on the RLS policies in 001_datasets.sql).

title: Commit or gitignore untracked planning docs and ExportTab.jsx
description: Three untracked files in the working tree: PLAN-save-project.md, PRD-petakarta-v2.md, src/components/Sidebar/ExportTab.jsx. Decision needed: (1) commit ExportTab.jsx if it's used (referenced in Sidebar tabs?), (2) move planning docs to docs/ and commit, or add to .gitignore.

title: Phase 1: Project Management & Sharing
description: Foundation phase for PetaKarta v2. Save/share UX, slugs, visibility model, embed, user profiles, limits. See docs/PLAN-v2.md.

title: Save project UX: Save / Save As / Rename / New Project
description:
Implement document-oriented project workflow in header toolbar.
- Project name display in header (click to rename inline)
- Save button: update existing or prompt name if new
- Overflow menu: Save As, New Project, My Projects
- Keyboard shortcut: Ctrl+S
- Update PLAN-save-project.md to use layerTreeStore (not legacy mapStore)
- Refactor ProjectsPanel to browse-only focus (remove save-as input)
See PLAN-save-project.md for detailed spec.

title: Project slug support
description:
Add human-readable URLs for shared projects.
- Add `slug` TEXT UNIQUE column to projects table (migration)
- Auto-generate slug from title on save (lowercase, hyphens, max 60 chars)
- Uniqueness: append -2, -3 etc. if taken
- Resolve slug in useAppRoute: /p/<slug> → load project
- Reserved slugs: gallery, about, new, p
- Slug editable in project settings
- Backward compat: ?project=<uuid> still works

title: Visibility model: private / unlisted / public
description:
Replace is_public boolean with 3-level visibility.
- Add `visibility` TEXT column: 'private' | 'unlisted' | 'public' (default: 'private')
- Migrate existing is_public data
- Update RLS: public/unlisted readable by anyone, private by owner only
- UI: dropdown selector in save/project settings
- Gallery only shows 'public' projects
- Unlisted: accessible via URL but not discoverable
- Keep is_public temporarily for backward compat

title: Embed snippet generator
description:
Share tab/section with embed options for unlisted/public projects.
- Copy URL button (slug-based URL)
- Copy <iframe> snippet with configurable width/height
- Preview of embed
- Only available when project is unlisted or public
- Add to Sidebar as Share tab or in project settings modal

title: Per-user resource limits (tier-aware)
description:
Enforce storage and project limits based on user tier.
- RLS policy on datasets: max 10 (free) / 50 (pro) per user, joins to profiles.tier
- RLS policy on projects: max 20 (free) / 100 (pro) per user
- Application-side storage size check on upload (50MB free / 500MB pro)
- Max single file: 10MB (free) / 50MB (pro)
- Show usage in UI: "3/10 datasets used" in dataset panel
- Graceful error messages when limit hit

title: OG meta tags for shared projects
description:
Dynamic meta tags for social media link previews.
- Shared project URLs should show title, description, preview image
- Options: (a) Supabase Edge Function serves HTML shell with meta tags then redirects to SPA, or (b) prerender service
- Use thumbnail_url if available, otherwise default PetaKarta preview image
- Meta tags: og:title, og:description, og:image, twitter:card

title: User profiles: table, trigger, CRUD, UI
description:
User profile system extending Supabase auth.
- Create `profiles` table: id (FK to auth.users), full_name, username (unique), avatar_url, tier ('free'|'pro'), timestamps
- Postgres trigger: auto-create profile on signup, populate from Google OAuth metadata
- RLS: public read, self-update only, tier not user-writable (service role only)
- profilesService.js: fetch, update profile
- Update authStore: fetch/cache profile on login
- ProfileModal component: edit full name, username
- Show author name on public project cards in gallery
- Backfill migration for existing users (query auth.users, insert profiles)

title: Phase 2: Basemap Expansion & Catalog Foundation
description: More basemap choices + infrastructure for catalog layers. See docs/PLAN-v2.md Phase 2.

title: Expand basemap options: satellite, topo, carto
description:
Add CORS-friendly basemap options to the basemap switcher.
Current: OSM only.
Add:
- Esri World Imagery (satellite): https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Imagery/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}
- Esri World Topo: https://server.arcgisonline.com/ArcGIS/rest/services/World_Topo_Map/MapServer/tile/{z}/{y}/{x}
- OpenTopoMap: https://tile.opentopomap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
- CartoDB Light: https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png
- CartoDB Dark: https://basemaps.cartocdn.com/dark_all/{z}/{x}/{y}.png

Update src/utils/basemapSources.js with new entries.
Update basemap switcher UI to show all options (may need icons or labels).
Add attributions per basemap source.
Add unit test for basemapSources.js (verify all URLs are well-formed, all have attributions).

title: Add catalog layer type to layer tree store
description:
Add 'catalog' as a third layer type in the layer tree system.

In layerTreeStore.js:
- Add `addCatalogLayer(catalogEntry)` action
- Catalog layer structure:
  { id, type: 'catalog', name, title, visible, opacity, order,
    catalogConfig: { catalogId, type: 'wms'|'wmts'|'xyz', url, layers, format, attribution, bbox } }
- Include in getSortedLayers, toggleVisibility, setOpacity, removeLayer, reorderLayers
- In getProjectState/loadProject: persist catalogConfig (no data blob)

Add unit tests for the store: addCatalogLayer, remove, toggle, persist/load round-trip.

title: Create static catalog registry with verified endpoints
description:
Create src/data/catalogLayers.js with curated, CORS-friendly tile services.

Structure per entry:
{ id, name, provider, category, type: 'xyz'|'wms'|'wmts', url, layers (if WMS),
  format, attribution, bbox, cors: true, thumbnail (optional) }

Categories: 'Basemap', 'Imagery', 'Topography', 'Thematic'

Initial entries (all verified CORS ✅):
- Esri World Imagery (xyz)
- Esri World Topo (xyz)
- Esri NatGeo World Map (xyz)
- OpenTopoMap (xyz)
- CartoDB Positron/DarkMatter (xyz)
- HOT OSM (xyz, from openstreetmap.fr)

Add unit test: verify all entries have required fields, URLs are valid, no duplicate IDs.

title: Catalog layer rendering with useCatalogLayers hook
description:
Create src/hooks/useCatalogLayers.js to render catalog layers on the OL map.

- Watch layerTreeStore for catalog-type layers
- Create OL sources based on catalogConfig.type:
  - 'xyz' → ol/source/XYZ
  - 'wms' → ol/source/TileWMS
  - 'wmts' → ol/source/WMTS (future, stub for now)
- Manage OL layer lifecycle (add/remove/update visibility/opacity/z-index)
- Similar pattern to useAdminLayer.js and useUserLayers.js
- Register in MapView.jsx

Add to MapView.jsx: useCatalogLayers(map)

title: Add 'Browse Catalog' and 'Custom URL' to AddLayerModal
description:
Extend AddLayerModal with two new tabs for adding catalog and custom URL layers.

Tab 1 - 'Catalog':
- Import CATALOG_LAYERS from src/data/catalogLayers.js
- Searchable list grouped by category
- Each entry shows: name, provider, type badge (XYZ/WMS)
- Click to add to layer tree via addCatalogLayer()
- Disable/gray out if already added

Tab 2 - 'Custom URL':
- Input fields: URL template, type dropdown (XYZ/WMS), layer name (if WMS)
- Optional: attribution text
- 'Add Layer' button — validates URL format, then adds via addCatalogLayer with custom config
- For XYZ: validate URL contains {z}/{x}/{y}
- For WMS: validate URL contains required params or we add them

title: Phase 3: Styling & Data Improvements
description: Better styling, remote GeoJSON, attribution, color ramp upgrade. See docs/PLAN-v2.md Phase 3.

title: Remote GeoJSON URL as layer source
description:
Add ability to load GeoJSON from a URL (not just file upload).

In AddLayerModal 'Custom URL' tab:
- Add 'GeoJSON URL' as a type option alongside XYZ/WMS
- When selected: show URL input, display name input
- On submit: fetch the URL, validate it's valid GeoJSON, add as user layer
- Store URL reference in userConfig (storagePath = null, remoteUrl = url)
- On project load: re-fetch from URL (like uploaded datasets re-fetch from storage)
- CORS required on the source — show error if fetch fails

In useUserLayers.js:
- Handle layers with remoteUrl: fetch GeoJSON from URL instead of Supabase storage

Add test: validate GeoJSON URL detection logic.

title: Attribution/source field on map (petakarta-03s)
description:
Add a text input for data source attribution displayed on the map.

- Already have `attribution` field in layerTreeStore (mapTitle, legendTitle, attribution)
- Add UI in MapTab: text input for attribution/source (e.g. 'Source: BPS 2024')
- Display on map canvas via MapAttribution component (already exists — check if it uses the field)
- Include in PNG exports
- Persist in project state_json (already in getProjectState)

This may already be partially implemented — check MapAttribution.jsx and MapTab.jsx first.

title: Color ramp picker with grouped dropdown (petakarta-8ea)
description:
Replace the current color ramp grid with a grouped dropdown.

In ColorRampPicker.jsx:
- Replace grid layout with a dropdown/select that groups presets by category
- Groups: Sequential (Blues, Greens, Reds, Oranges, Purples, YlOrRd, OrRd, PuBu, YlGn, Viridis, Magma, Inferno), Diverging (RdBu, BrBG, Spectral, PiYG, PRGn)
- Each option shows a color swatch preview (small gradient bar) next to the name
- Keep the reverse toggle button
- Use PRESET_GROUPS from colorUtils.js (already defined)

Add test for ColorRampPicker rendering (check groups exist, all presets listed).

title: Improved vector styling: dash patterns, point size, label customization
description:
Enhance the style controls for vector layers.

Line layers:
- Dash pattern selector: solid, dashed, dotted (use OL lineDash property)
- Line width control (already exists as strokeWidth)

Point layers:
- Point radius slider (already exists as pointRadius in some places)
- Outline width control

Polygon labels:
- Font size control (default 11px, range 8-18px)
- Label color picker

Update StyleTab.jsx (both admin and user layer style panels) with new controls.
Update styleUtils.js and useUserLayers.js to use new style properties.
Store new properties in layer config (adminConfig / userConfig).

title: Social media share buttons (petakarta-cax)
Phase 4: Output & Gallery
description: Print-quality export, thumbnails, gallery improvements. See docs/PLAN-v2.md Phase 4. Social sharing already done in Phase 3.

title: Print-quality PNG export with DPI control
description:
Upgrade the map export to support higher DPI for print output.

In MapTab.jsx (or ExportTab):
- DPI selector: 72 (screen), 150 (web), 300 (print) — replace current "resolution" 1x/2x with DPI-based
- Paper size hint (optional): show approximate dimensions at selected DPI
- Scale bar rendering in export (optional, nice-to-have)

In useMapExport.js:
- Accept DPI parameter instead of just resolution multiplier
- Calculate pixel ratio from DPI (dpi / 96)
- Use OL's map.renderSync() or rendercomplete pattern at higher resolution
- Composite legend, title, attribution at matching DPI scale
- Output filename includes DPI: e.g. indonesia-map-300dpi-{timestamp}.png

Add test for DPI-to-pixel-ratio conversion logic.

title: Auto-generate thumbnail on project save
description:
Capture a small map preview when saving a project.

- On save (in Header.jsx handleSave/handleSaveAs): capture map canvas as small PNG
- Use html2canvas or OL canvas API at low resolution (e.g. 400x300)
- Convert to base64 or upload to Supabase Storage as thumbnail
- Store thumbnail_url in projects table (column already planned in migration)
- If thumbnail column doesn't exist yet, add migration

Need to add thumbnail_url column to projects:
ALTER TABLE projects ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS thumbnail_url TEXT;

Use the thumbnail in Gallery and OG meta tags.

title: Gallery improvements: thumbnails, search, pagination
description:
Upgrade the gallery page with better browsing.

In GalleryPage.jsx:
- Show thumbnail image on project cards (from thumbnail_url, with placeholder if none)
- Add search input: filter by project name (client-side for now)
- Add sort: newest first (default), oldest first
- Pagination: load 12 per page, "Load more" button or page numbers
- Card layout: thumbnail on top, title, author, date below
- Responsive grid: 1 col mobile, 2 col tablet, 3-4 col desktop

Update listPublicProjects in projectsService.js:
- Select thumbnail_url in the query
- Support pagination params (already has limit/offset)

title: Create default OG preview image
description:
Create public/og-default.png (1200x630) as the default social preview.

- Simple branded image: "PetaKarta" title, tagline, map silhouette of Indonesia
- Can be created programmatically with canvas or as a static PNG
- Referenced in index.html og:image meta tag (already added with TODO)
- Used when projects don't have their own thumbnail
